columns._doc: Column-band labeling of the XYCut claim lane (pdfdig-ir Get-ColumnBands). narrow_width_frac: blocks narrower than this fraction of text width participate in left-edge clustering; cluster_gap_frac: a left-edge gap larger than this fraction of text width starts a new cluster; span_width_frac: blocks at least this wide are labeled 'span'; assign_tolerance_frac: slack when matching a block's left edge to a cluster range. Values tuned on specimen 2508.11646 (two-column IEEE).

rules._doc: Thin-bbox rule tagging in the paths lane. A non-bezier path whose bbox is at most max_thickness_pt thick and at least min_length_pt long is tagged hrule/vrule. Specimen 2508.11646: 14 hrules + 7 vrules across 18 pages.

figure_regions._doc: CONSUMER PHASE (pdfdig-figures.ps1): cluster each page's Lane-4 vector-path bboxes into figure regions via hdbscan.exe rectangle-gap (density over white-space gaps); stray rules fall out as noise (-1). Per-page. min_pts/min_cluster_size = HDBSCAN density params; a page with at most min_pts paths is grouped as one region flagged too_few_to_cluster. allow_single_cluster lets a lone figure be one cluster while still splitting well-separated multi-figure pages. KIND tagging (nothing dropped): a region whose union bbox is thinner than degenerate_min_extent_pt on either axis is kind=degenerate (a rule/line cluster, ~zero area); otherwise a mark when its TEXT-NORMALIZED area (area / body_font_pt^2 = em^2, i.e. how many glyphs big it is) is below min_region_area_em2; else a big-but-SPARSE region (ink density = paths / em^2 below min_region_density) is kind=sparse -- a phantom where a few furniture/QED strokes' union bbox spans a text column (a footnote rule + scattered QED squares would otherwise read as a ~2000 em^2 'figure'); else a figure. DENSITY, not area, separates a big DENSE diagram from a big SPARSE phantom (area alone cannot). em^2 makes the mark floor transport across page AND font size (a mark is glyph-scale, <~1 em^2; a figure is diagram-scale). NB rule-tagged strokes are KEPT in clustering -- in this corpus figures ARE largely axis-aligned rules (interval bars, diagram arrows/axes), so excluding them shatters real figures (ph-zigzag 2111.15058v3: 29% of Figure 2's ink is hrules); furniture-only regions are rejected by the density gate instead. Corpus evidence (14-paper inbox scan 2026-07-03): the mark/figure split is NOT universally bimodal -- many papers are a size continuum from fragmented complex figures -- so this is a conservative glyph-scale FLOOR (catches true marks, ~2 em^2 = the old 200pt2 at 10pt), NOT a bimodal-valley estimate. min_region_area_pt2 is the fallback floor used only when body_font_pt can't be read (letters lane absent). fragmentation_flag_min_clusters: a page yielding more than this many regions triggers the DE-FRAGMENTATION pass (defrag_enabled): the consumer walks the per-page dendrogram for the fragment-adjacency elbow (the largest log-gap in the distances at which DISTINCT sub-clusters first merge -- below it = intra-figure fragment joins, above = inter-figure/column), and re-runs hdbscan with that distance as --cluster-selection-epsilon so intra-figure fragments merge while figures stay separate. defrag_min_elbow_log_gap: the elbow's log-gap must exceed this or the page is left alone (no clear structure -> don't merge a continuum). summary.fragmentation_suspect_pages counts triggered pages; summary.defragged_pages counts those actually merged. CAPTION reattachment (caption_enabled): each kind=figure region is associated with its caption -- the nearest Lane-3 text block directly BELOW it (figures) or, failing that, ABOVE (tables), horizontally overlapping by at least caption_min_overlap_frac of the NARROWER of figure/block width (min() -- a short 'Fig. N' caption fully under a wide figure must not be rejected by a figure-width denominator; the cue + gap gates still exclude in-text references) and within caption_max_gap_em text-heights vertically. GEOMETRY finds the candidates (adjacent, overlapping, within gap); the caption_cue_words match (Figure/Fig/Table N, prefix-scanned in the block's first ~14 chars) SELECTS the caption among them -- an adjacent section heading or body paragraph (no cue) is NOT attached, and a caption-less region stays null rather than grabbing the wrong block; a mid-sentence 'see Figure 3' reference is excluded by both the length cap and non-adjacency. The region's caption field carries {block_id, bbox, text, cue, position, gap}; summary.captioned_figures counts hits. SUBFIGURE GROUPING (subfigure_grouping_enabled): after caption reattachment, kind=figure regions that share the SAME caption (page, block_id) are merged into ONE region -- a \begin{figure} float with N side-by-side subfigures yields N regions that each reattach to the float's single caption below them, so the shared caption is the ground-truth grouping signal (each float has exactly one caption), making this principled rather than a spatial threshold. Union bbox + concatenated members + recomputed area/density; kind stays figure; flag=subfigure_merged. Matches the oracle's float granularity and yields ONE faithful figure crop (all panels + shared caption) instead of N. summary.subfigure_groups / subfigures_merged count it. caption_max_gap_em CALIBRATED to 4.5 (2026-07-05, post-consensus circle-back): the two surviving gap-miss captions sit at 4.15-4.16em (2210 Fig 7 at 45.3pt/10.9pt body, 2403 Fig 5 at 43.2pt/10pt) while the nearest in-text-reference candidate sits at 5.06em (2205 'of Fig. 11', 50.6pt) -- 4.5 splits that margin, and the corpus-wide attachment diff at 4.5-vs-4.0 added EXACTLY the two intended captions and lost none (the earlier do-not-bump caveat was conditioned on pre-consensus regions; they have since been reshaped and re-measured).

letters._doc: V_letters evidence view (Join-FigureViews letters pass, issues/clustering/letters-elevation.md): the third elevation after paths (born) and xobjects (Lane 5) -- SELECTED Lane-3 letter blocks join region formation as EVIDENCE, never as HDBSCAN points (small body fragments would distort the calibrated density landscape). Selector (calibrated 2026-07-06, scratch/letters-calib.ps1, 2894 blocks: in-figure blocks sit ON the ink at nearest-path-gap p95 0.39em vs body median 33.6em): block width <= max_width_em AND 1 <= letters <= max_letters (blocks with NO letter back-refs are never selected) AND, at bridge time, within t_bridge_em of path ink (0.75: commutative-diagram corner labels sit at 0.51-0.55em -- arrows stop deliberately short of their text nodes -- while the nearest NON-participants sit at 1.89em+ ('B in' body fragments) and 8.8em+ (stray words/page numbers); measured 2210 pg13/pg17 2026-07-06). MEMBERSHIP: every path component within reach records the block (letter_block_ids on the region; the CROP bbox unions those boxes -- kind/area/density formulas ignore them at v1). BRIDGE: >= 2 distinct components within reach of ONE block = their shared node label/connector -> union (heals label-split diagram fragments; the >=2 rule neutralizes small body fragments beside lone radical-bar/rule strokes -- nothing to bridge). Blocks later CLAIMED as captions are stripped from letter lists post-attachment. Rides the consensus pass (disabled when consensus is). summary.letter_blocks / letter_bridges.

banded_metric._doc: Full T3 -- backbone-CONDITIONED formation (tier3-engineering-plan section 2-B; BandedRectangleGapMetric, calibrated scratch/band-weld-calib.ps1 2026-07-10). T3-lite VETOES in-flow damage post-hoc; this PREVENTS it: the per-page clustering runs rectangle-gap-banded, inflating a pair's VERTICAL gap by lambda x its overlap with the page's prose BANDS, so formations stop chaining across body text (measured: 189/492 corpus figure regions cross an interior prose line, incl. two CAPTIONED paragraph-welds in 1608.02165v1 that carry a paragraph of body text into their crops). BANDS = individual PROSE / heading-candidate NODE bboxes (nodes.jsonl) at least band_min_width_em text-heights wide with positive height -- NODE level, not block level: a mixed paragraph's prose lines band while its embedded display line does not, and an equation stack never bands (block-level fails BOTH ways; the probe header carries the three-iteration record). The conditioning is CONTINUOUS, so no guard heuristic is needed: a ~1em interior subcaption row (legitimate inside multi-panel figures) costs lambda*1em and stays merged, while a welded paragraph costs lambda*10em and splits -- the calibrated target/guard margin is ~10x. The sidecar p{page}.bands.jsonl rides the per-page points file and the defrag re-run inherits it via the copied args. Requires metric=rectangle-gap (fails loud otherwise); a missing nodes lane quietly stays plain (test fixtures). DEFAULT OFF: this is the FIRST change on the formation path itself -- PRIMARY invariance is empirical, not structural -- enable only after BOTH corpora gate clean.

stray_eject._doc: C-prime STRAY EJECT (Select-StrayEject; tier3-engineering-plan section 2-C rescope; statistic LOCKED by scratch/stray-eject-calib.ps1 after three measured iterations - the probe header carries the v1->v2->v3 record). B-4 proved the monster-weld class is a cluster-SELECTION defect: allow_single_cluster EOM selects the ROOT on lone-blob pages and absorbs remote strays at ANY distance (1608 p8 stays 1 cluster / 0 noise even at banded lambda=20), so the render welds a paragraph of body text into the crop. C-0 proved no global persistence band exists (real figures assemble as late as ~17em while other real figures die at 0.7em). The eject is the surviving RELATIVE form, post-selection: walk each selected cluster's dendrogram spine from its members' LCA down into the larger-member child; thin far sides (<= min_cluster_size-1 members) are ladder RUNGS (stray candidates), a FAT split marks the core top (multi-panel joins are never thin -> structurally unejectable), noise-only far sides contribute distance only. CLAMP the spine distance sequence at contact scale (floor_em text-heights: sub-glyph distances are all touching; micro-gaps between them are the v2 failure mode) and find the largest natural-log gap; if >= min_log_gap (ln, the defrag-elbow convention: 1.0 ~ 2.72x), eject every rung above the cut to noise. Uniform chains (sparse real diagrams, 2112) never show a decade gap -> stay; a ~2.5x colorbar/legend satellite sits under 1.0 -> stays. Calibrated corpus-wide: 1608 p8 ejects exactly its 2 strays (path+xobject, lnGap 2.43), p9 exactly 4 (2.07), zero dissolutions, 71 clusters / 173 members. Uses the FIRST hdbscan run's dendrogram (the defrag epsilon re-run changes labels, never the tree). PLACEMENT (C-prime-3 gate discovery): runs POST-CAPTION on formed regions, not on labels - label-level ejection regressed PRIMARY (voroninski 0.35->0.43): in a caption_split weld the far 'strays' can be a TINY REAL FIGURE (<= tail_max paths, too small to ever cluster alone) that the splitter rescues into its own captioned region; post-split it owns its own region and the size guard skips it structurally. A captioned region keeps caption AND kind=figure (the A2b family invariant) - only members/bbox trim; uncaptioned regions re-gate kind (the SECONDARY win). DEFAULT OFF until C-prime-3 gates both corpora.

inflow_demotion._doc: Topological-prior T3-lite -- the IN-FLOW (backbone) VETO (Set-InflowKind, issues/clustering/topological-prior.md section 3 first increment). Floats live in WHITESPACE; display-math clusters, equation ink and inline embedded images live INSIDE the text-column flow. Wide Lane-3 blocks (width >= wide_block_em text-heights = body/equation lines) form the page's text BACKBONE; an UNCAPTIONED kind=figure region whose bbox is covered >= min_cover by backbone blocks demotes to kind=inflow (leaves both gate populations and the crop deliverable). ANY provenance -- older papers embed equation ink as xobjects (1506.01437v2's entire false-positive population). CALIBRATED 2026-07-07 (scratch/inflow-calib.ps1, voroninski target + ph-zigzag negative control): real diagrams sit at cov ~0% (ph-zigzag 33/35 regions at 0), real uncaptioned floats at 0-40% (2008's caption-missed plot: 0%), equation ink at 70-100%; the one text-welded formation defect (2112 id6, 56%) stays below the 0.7 cut. Post-caption pass -- PRIMARY invariant by construction. summary.inflow counts demotions.

furniture_demotion._doc: Topological-prior T1 (Set-FurnitureKind, issues/clustering/topological-prior.md): demote UNCAPTIONED pure-path kind=figure regions that are equation/decoration FURNITURE (overline+underbrace rule clusters, framed-paragraph borders, interval-annotation strips) to kind=furniture, so they leave the SECONDARY inline-diagram population and its crops (pdfdig-images renders kind=figure only). Runs LAST -- captioned regions are never touched, so PRIMARY is invariant by construction. furniture <= NO areal member (min extent of every member <= areal_min_extent_pt: furniture is pure stroke ink; boxes, blobs and filled arrowheads disqualify) AND cycle rank b1=0 at cycle_radius_em (|E|-|V|+|C| over the member proximity graph -- diagrams close circuits, even a box drawn as 4 strokes; strips and braces never do) AND strip-shaped (aspect >= min_aspect OR height <= max_height_em). CALIBRATED 2026-07-06 on crop-labeled residuals (scratch/furniture-calib.ps1): the known-furniture set (2210 id29 overline strip; 2403 framed-box rules + interval annotations) all match; the danger classes are spared by construction -- text-node commutative diagrams (arrows only, b1=0 in path space because the corners are LETTERS) and barcode/interval-bar figures (all-thin, b1=0) are both squarish/tall and fail the strip clause. max_members: larger regions are never furniture (perf guard). summary.furniture counts demotions.

caption_split._doc: V_caption m2 increment (a) -- INTERIOR SPLIT (Split-CaptionInteriorRegions), the C-fix from the 2026-07-05 re-diagnosis: a caption is definitionally a float BOUNDARY, so a caption-shaped cue block strictly INSIDE a kind=figure region is NEGATIVE co-membership evidence that the region welded two floats (2205 pg8 = Fig 7+Fig 8 in one region; 2210 pg32 = Fig 14's caption at 46% height of a 1283 em^2 region). Members split at the block's mid-line, topmost caption first, recursing for multi-caption monsters; the splitting caption attaches to its upper sub-region (captions sit below their figure), the parent's pass-1 caption follows the bottom remainder; every sub-region re-gates kind and carries flag=caption_split. GUARDS (the cue regex alone matches in-text references): shape (cue at block start, height <= max_block_em text-heights); STYLE (the block's cue-word form + separator must match a style learned from THIS paper's pass-1 claimed captions -- 'Fig. 7' is Fig+none, 'Figure 14:' is Figure+colon; a paper with no claimed captions is never split; verified discriminative: 2205's interior body line 'Figure 12 shows...' fails style, 2403's 'Figure 2 illustrates...' paragraph fails height); place (strictly interior by margin_em on BOTH edges -- bottom-band overhang is not a weld -- with caption_min_overlap_frac horizontal overlap). summary.caption_splits counts split parents. SEP-RELAXATION (voroninski out-of-sample circle-back 2026-07-06): a candidate carrying the cue-then-SEPARATOR signature ('Figure 7:') uses max_block_sep_em instead of max_block_em -- real multi-line captions run 6-8 lines (1701's survey captions at 6.2-8.3em were guard-blocked) while in-text prose essentially never separators after the figure number (the hazards 'Figure 2 illustrates'/'Figure 12 shows' have none and keep the tight cap); prefix allowance widened to 4 junk glyphs incl. digits ('> 2 Figure 1:' -- stray superscripts merged into the block). NO-STYLE BOOTSTRAP (bootstrap_no_style, 2026-07-07 A2 attachment tail): a paper whose ONLY figure caption IS the interior weld it needs has 0 pass-1 claims -> no style learnable -> the split would bail (the chicken-and-egg that left 1705.07576v3 Figure 1 uncaptioned: its plot's 44 paths sit ABOVE the caption, the region only dips below on 2 degenerate bitmap points). When styles is empty, split ONLY from a self-evident cue-then-SEPARATOR caption ('Figure 1:') strictly interior with full overlap -- the separator is the discriminator in-text prose lacks. Calibrated scratch/caption-bootstrap-calib.ps1: fires on EXACTLY 1705 reg7 corpus-wide (0 false); ph-zigzag has no 0-claim papers so it is byte-identical there. BOTTOM-BAND ATTACH+TRIM (bottom_band_attach, 2026-07-07 A2b): an interior cue-then-SEP caption whose midline cut is DEGENERATE with BELOW empty (every member center above it) is not a weld but a below-caption the region bbox merely OVERSHOOTS -- the ink floors above the caption top while clip paths / an oversized xobject placement reach past it (1701 Fig 7: 100 plot members floor at 518, 6 clip rects span to 399, caption top 495; Fig 15: one oversized bitmap padding past its diagram). Add-FigureCaptions misses it (region overshoot -> negative below-gap) and the split finds nothing to cut, so the caption falls through both. When no weld cut is made, attach the topmost such caption to the whole region and pull the crop bbox bottom UP to the caption top (stops the crop welding the caption -- and a trailing body line for Fig 15 -- into the figure); area/em2/density recomputed, kind stays figure. Calibrated scratch/bottom-band-calib.ps1: fires on EXACTLY 1701 Fig 7 + Fig 15 across both corpora, 0 false attachments, 0 trim hazards; ph-zigzag byte-identical.

consensus._doc: CONSENSUS m1 (Join-FigureViews, issues/clustering/consensus-milestone1-design.md): OR-combine of two per-page co-membership VIEWS in one union-find pass -- V_geom (the HDBSCAN partition, as-is) and V_stream (contiguous content-stream draw-runs over Lane-4 paths). Per-page path ids are contiguous by construction, so the splitter is the SPATIAL JUMP between consecutive ids, never an id gap: stream blocks = the id-sorted path sequence split where the consecutive rectangle-gap exceeds stream_jump_em text-heights (a TikZ/xy diagram is one draw-run that stays spatially coherent; between two figures the pen teleports). Within a block, consecutive paths within t_far_em chain-union and sub-chains re-glue to fixpoint while their union bboxes stay within t_far_em (block-scoped) -- t_far carries the separation load when the jump splitter misses a close float boundary. XObjects carry no stream evidence at m1 (separate id sequence); they still union via V_geom. rule is named config-as-data: m1 supports 'inclusive' (OR); 'mutual'/'mean' arrive with the SymmetrizationRule port (m2). CALIBRATION (scratch/stream-calib.ps1, ph-zigzag 2026-07-05): true float-boundary teleports (consecutive pairs straddling two CAPTIONED regions) min 7.24em / p50 26em; intra-figure steps p50 0.63em / p95 7.9em; zero page-spanning paths corpus-wide -> stream_jump_em 6.0 catches 100% of observed boundaries with margin, t_far_em 4.0 sits ~45% under the boundary minimum. summary counters: stream_blocks, consensus_unions, consensus_changed_pages; regions whose component the stream view reshaped carry flag=consensus_merged.

script._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE (not consulted by the substrate emitter). Sub/superscript call from size ratio + baseline delta, ported from Markpig Extractor.cs constants (validated on p1..p5 in recon): a glyph smaller than size_ratio_max x line size whose baseline deviates beyond sub_min_drop/super_min_rise points is a script candidate.

line_grouping._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE. Baseline clustering tolerance in points (Extractor.cs GroupLines) and the gap fraction of line size treated as an inter-word space (Extractor.cs SpaceFrac; PDFs encode spaces as gaps, not glyphs).

headings._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE heading-candidate call from per-document calibration: a line whose modal size is at least min_size_ratio_over_body x body size sits in the tier ladder; a line at body size qualifies when at least bold_line_frac of its letters are bold-by-name (the -Medi/CMBX cue — IsBold flag is unreliable, capability map 1a). Candidates are cross-derived against the bookmark outline (normalized contains-match, page +/-1) — confirmation is a flag, never a gate. tier_merge_gap_pt: adjacent ladder sizes closer than this merge into one tier BAND — office pipelines emit continuous size jitter (specimen 2504.09042: 18 raw sizes 16.3-16.7 etc), not TeX's quantized magsteps; more than max_tiers_before_flag bands after merging flags tier_ladder_noisy.

display_math._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE formula-block call: a line whose math-role letter fraction is at least min_math_frac, no wider than max_width_frac_of_block of its block, emits as formula-block. Consecutive formula lines closer than stack_gap_factor x line size share a formula group and are flagged needs_2d_assembly (fractions/matrices pending the C# AST tier).

math_assembler._doc: 1.5-D math structure assembler (math-assembler.ps1): recursive size-tier script nesting for display math. size_ratio: a glyph smaller than base*size_ratio can be a script (CM ladder 10/7/5 -> 0.75 separates tiers); baseline_tol_frac: baseline delta beyond this fraction of the glyph's own size counts as displaced (sub/super). Inverts TeX's forward script placement so t/v/(i+1) at sizes 10/7/5 assemble as t_{v_{i+1}} not the invalid flat t_{v}_{1}.

furniture._doc: CLASSIFIER-PHASE marker call (running heads, page numbers, the arXiv stamp): a line whose baseline sits within margin_frac of the page top/bottom at no more than body size, or whose modal orientation is not Horizontal (rotated stamps/sidebars).

dla._doc: DLA algorithm option overrides (IDlaOptions), applied when constructing segmenter/word-extractor instances. Empty = library defaults (Docstrum within=3.0/between=1.3, XYCut MinimumWidth=1). Populate per-domain when a specimen motivates it.
